ASMRchives "Up": Carl's Chair
Take a listen as Pixar Archivists along with Bryn Imagire, unbox Bryn's practical model of Carl's chair created for Pixar's feature film, UP (2009). Headphones are recommended for the best audio experience! See more on THE PIXAR SHOW!

author: Pixar YouTube
text:
UP Videogame Loads Fast | Full Episode on @pixar!
Join the Producer of Pixar's UP, Jonas Rivera, as he attempts to play the videogame for "UP" for the very first time alongside some more experienced gamers at Pixar... this is PIXARCADE where Pixar filmmakers share behind the scenes stories as they play the games from their films! Want to tell us what to play next? Let us know in the comments!!
